scope: Twenty-eight custom invocation comparisons across four shell aliases retain argv[0], login and POSIX behavior, known-applet name collisions and printenv with a login name and clean environment. Pinned standalone native GNU printenv is the oracle; candidate helpers remain integrated. Every traced candidate image requires complete clean heap and descriptor summaries.

args: exec -a specialname "$THIS_SH" --noprofile --norc -c 'printf "%s\n" "$0"; set -o | while read option value; do case $option in posix) printf "%s:%s\n" "$option" "$value";; esac; done'
